in_marathi.name: Chiranjivi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chiranjivi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chiranjivi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chira' meaning 'eternal' and 'Jivi' meaning 'living'. This name is bestowed upon individuals believed to possess the qualities of longevity, immortality, and vitality. In Hindu mythology, there are several gods and characters known as Chiranjivis, who are believed to have the power of eternal life.
